services.desc: Spark! Places of Innovation, a traveling exhibition from the Smithsonian’s Museum on Main Street (MoMS) program, has chosen the KACC for its first stop for its Texas Tour May 16-June 28, 2026. Only six venues in Texas were chosen to host the exhibit.Spark! will is an exhibit that dives into innovation and invention happening in rural America. In small towns across America, people are creating new products, taking risks, meeting challenges together, and seizing upon exciting opportunities that change local life and sometimes reach far beyond. blurb: The mission of the Kerr Arts & Cultural Center is to be a catalyst for enriching the cultural life of the community and supporting artists of the Hill Country through exhibitions, instruction in the arts and crafts, and educational programs for adults and young people.
